nvidia.notes: Width AND height each independently constrained to the SAME 10-value enum [768,832,896,960,1024,1088,1152,1216,1280,1344] -- NOT a continuous 320-1536 range as the current service_params.json declares. Because both axes are capped at 1344 max / 768 min, extreme ratios (3:1, 1:3, 2:1, 1:2) are UNACHIEVABLE -- nearest achievable pair is used and the true ratio is not preserved for those 4 presets. Sourced from the self-hosted NIM container OpenAPI spec (FLUX.1-dev + SD3.5-large both confirmed identical); the hosted ai.api.nvidia.com/v1/genai/{model} endpoint our backend calls is assumed (not independently re-confirmed) to share this schema -- same publisher, same container family.
